## Signal -> enrich -> route
**Purpose:** turn a senior GTM hire or a funding round (SEC Form D) into a HubSpot company + an owned, dated task.
**Trigger:** signed POST from gtm-signal-detector (`src/deliver.py`).
**Owner:** Kanchi Pareek.
**Fails loudly:** bad signature = 401, bad payload = 400, HubSpot error = 500 so the detector retries / dead-letters.
**Setup:** fill the Config node, pick the HubSpot credential on the 4 HubSpot nodes.
